newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem rallies after analysts' upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Elkem rallies after analysts' upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA rose strongly in robust trade on Monday buoyed by recent upwards adjustments by analysts, brokers said.
Elkem was up 6.5 percent at 106.50 crowns at 1155 GMT in 38.5 million crowns of business. The stock had hit an intra-day peak at 107.50 crowns.
Brokers said recent upward adjustments to analysts' recommendations had helped fuel the gain, combined with slightly better product prices and a general upswing in the Norwegian share market.
"Elkem has been lagging the market and is considered by some to be undervalued. There's a lot of money in the market today hunting limited value," said one broker.
The Oslo bourse started the week on a firm note as the Total index climbed 1.5 percent by mid-session to 942.79 points.
